text.aria-label: Title text 'Capacity of unmetered solar at the six MW Primaries, April to September 2025 (AC megawatts; one panel per Primary) Bar: 10th to 90th percentile. Dot: median. Dashed line: Feed-in Tariff register floor (no floor for D9). Orange: the calibrated probe. Blue: experiment 474's R4 table, hull of its two season-years. Green: experiment 479.'
text.tspan: Capacity of unmetered solar at the six MW Primaries, April to September 2025 (AC megawatts; one panel per Primary)
Bar: 10th to 90th percentile. Dot: median. Dashed line: Feed-in Tariff register floor (no floor for D9).
Orange: the calibrated probe. Blue: experiment 474's R4 table, hull of its two season-years. Green: experiment 479.
